name: adaptclose
description: Read call scores, coaching, and transcripts from your AdaptClose account, and manage the scorecard calls are graded on.

interface.longDescription:
AdaptClose scores in-person sales appointments against your company's scorecard. Connect your AdaptClose account and ask about your calls in plain words.

What you can do:
- Get a call's score, summary, and coaching tips that quote the rep.
- List calls by date, rep, team, score, or outcome.
- Search transcripts for a word or phrase, like price or financing.
- Read the scorecard, or replace it and publish a new version.
- Grade a new call from a link to the audio.
- Build a visit checklist.
- Review a door-to-door route and correct what a door landed on.

Who it's for: owners, sales managers, and reps at home service companies that already use AdaptClose.

You see what your role sees in the AdaptClose app. Reps see their own calls. Managers see their teams. Owners see the whole account. Phone numbers and email addresses in call data stay hidden unless you ask for them.

Limits: You need an AdaptClose account. Connecting doesn't create one. ChatGPT can't send a file from your computer, so share a link to the audio to grade a call. Grading a call uses your account's daily audio minutes. Only owners and managers can change the scorecard or build checklists.
defaultPrompt: How did my last call score? Quote the moment that cost the most points.
Find every call from last week where the homeowner pushed back on price.
Show my scorecard and the weight on each step.

positive.description: Show the connected account and role.
positive.prompt: Which AdaptClose account am I connected to, and what's my role?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the reviewer's AdaptClose account, says the role is owner, and names the plan.

positive.description: Read the scorecard calls are graded on.
positive.prompt: Show me the scorecard my sales calls are graded on, with the weight of each step.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each scorecard step in order with its weight and description.

positive.description: Get the score and top coaching tip for the newest call.
positive.prompt: Pull up my most recent graded call. What did it score, and what is the one thing the rep should fix?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest graded call, gives its overall score and summary, and names its lowest-scoring step with a coaching tip that quotes the rep.

positive.description: Search call transcripts for a topic.
positive.prompt: Find the moments in my calls where the homeowner talked about price.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns quoted transcript snippets that mention price, each tied to the call it came from. Phone numbers and email addresses stay hidden.

positive.description: Create a visit checklist. This is a write.
positive.prompt: Create a visit checklist called Roof inspection with three yes/no questions: Ladder secured? Photos of all four sides? Homeowner walked the roof line?
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a checklist named Roof inspection with the three questions as checkboxes, then replies with the checklist name and its three questions.

negative.description: Deleting calls is not supported. There is no delete tool, so ChatGPT should say it can't delete calls and point the user to their account owner or the AdaptClose app. No tool that changes data should run.
negative.prompt: Delete every call my reps recorded last month.

negative.description: Another company's data is out of reach. Every tool reads only the signed-in account, so ChatGPT should say it can only see this account. No other account's data is returned.
negative.prompt: Show me the call scores from Summit Windows' AdaptClose account.

negative.description: Billing is not supported. There is no plan or purchase tool, so ChatGPT should say it can't change the plan from here. It must not start a purchase or link to checkout.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my AdaptClose plan and buy more audio minutes.

publication.release_notes: First release. Get call scores, coaching tips, and transcripts. Search transcripts. Read or replace the scorecard. Grade a call from a link to the audio. Build visit checklists. Review door-to-door routes.
